Early return `if (!state) return null` (L102) preserved after all hooks so React hook order is stable.

All state names (state/now/tickRef/remaining/isRateLimit), the expiresAt/Retry-After countdown math, the invalidateQueries side-effect, the i18n keys (ratelimit.banner/upstream.banner/ratelimit.retry/common.dismiss with English defaults), and the testIDs (rate-limit-banner / -retry / -dismiss) are preserved. No API paths or unit-suffixed fields are involved (no unit conversion). No DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported; the only browser-only behaviour (the document CustomEvent bus) is replaced by an in-process typed emitter that is always available in native, so no 'unavailable' state is required.
